description: Volatile / non-deterministic functions (NOW / TODAY / RAND / RANDBETWEEN / RANDARRAY). Each member draws from a wall-clock or PRNG source that is intrinsically non-reproducible, so every case is registered as skip-oracle in tests/divergence.yaml. The closure exists purely to declare the divergence cluster — there is no oracle comparison.

cases.skipped: NOW() depends on wall-clock time; oracle comparison is intrinsically non-reproducible.
TODAY() depends on wall-clock date; oracle comparison is intrinsically non-reproducible.
RAND() draws from a non-seedable PRNG; oracle comparison is intrinsically non-reproducible.
RANDBETWEEN draws from a non-seedable PRNG; oracle comparison is intrinsically non-reproducible.
RANDARRAY draws from a non-seedable PRNG; oracle comparison is intrinsically non-reproducible.
